extractions.quote: An electrophysiological study showed normal conduction velocities in the common peroneal nerve (51.7 m/s), median nerve (70 m/s), sural nerve (49.6 m/s), and radial nerve (60.7 m/s). Needle detection in the paraspinal muscles at T2/T4, T8/T9, L2/L3, and L4/L5 showed nearly continuous motor unit firing; the motor unit potentials were small, and few were polyphasic (figure 1). Potentials related to volitional contraction were superimposed on this background. Needle detection at the deltoid and tibialis anterior muscle was normal.
